title: The Settings sub-toggles work independently (Service on, Finance off)
preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON, the Service sub-toggle ON and the Finance sub-toggle OFF.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Confirm the Service pages are shown.
  3. Confirm the Finance pages are not shown.
expected: The Service pages are shown and the Finance pages are hidden — the sub-toggles work independently.
